title: KANLab: TensorFlow Playground for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KANLab is a browser-based visualization tool designed to interactively teach the core concepts of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), forked from the widely successful TensorFlow Playground. To maximize educational clarity, KANLab omits residual connections and learnable scaling parameters found in modern KAN implementations, ensuring that displayed B-spline activation curves directly correspond to their underlying trainable control points. Users can inspect and modify activation functions, initialization schemes and observe gradient descent correcting manual disruptions. Furthermore, user can explore phenomena such as activation variance, interactive pruning, and re\-/training within a compact 2D machine learning setting. KANLab is open-source and available at https://kanlab.app/

translated_abstract: KANLab是一个基于浏览器的可视化工具，旨在以交互方式教授Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的核心概念，它从广受欢迎的TensorFlow Playground分叉而来。为了最大程度地提高教学清晰度，KANLab省略了现代KAN实现中的残差连接和可学习缩放参数，确保所显示的B样条激活曲线直接对应其底层的可训练控制点。用户可以检查和修改激活函数、初始化方案，并观察梯度下降如何纠正人为造成的扰动。此外，用户还可以在紧凑的2D机器学习环境中探索激活方差、交互式剪枝以及重新训练/继续训练等现象。KANLab是开源的，可在https://kanlab.app/获取。
tldr: KANLab是一个从TensorFlow Playground分叉而来的开源浏览器可视化工具，通过交互式展示B样条激活曲线、剪枝和梯度下降等现象，帮助用户直观学习Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的核心概念。
en_tdlr: KANLab is an open-source browser-based visualization tool forked from TensorFlow Playground that interactively teaches core concepts of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks through features such as B-spline activation curve visualization, interactive pruning, and gradient descent demonstration.
